title: Section scalar coherence with its computation unit
statement: Let $\Lambda,S$ be commutative condensed rings and $c:\Lambda\to S$ a morphism of ring objects [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-coefficient-morphisms]. Use the specified exact restriction of scalars, universal right-derived comparisons and section arrows [def-sfb-closed-test-scalar-comparison-maps] and the specified models and comparison maps [def-sfb-closed-test-scalar-model-diagrams]. SectionCoherence(c) holds: the universal section comparison satisfies its computation-unit equation on every complex, commutes with the ordinary unit section and its derived arrow, and commutes with direct-image evaluation.
